claim: Bram's alleged fiduciary self-dealing in affiliate fees
direct_or_derivative: derivative; the Company paid the fees and would receive any recovery

limitations.accrual: Affiliate engagement on 2022-08-15 and each allegedly excessive payment from 2022-09-01 onward; waived regardless of timeliness.
limitations.tolling_argument: The $375,000 is the identified 2022 and 2023 fixed payments outside a three-year lookback from 2026-10-08, absent tolling; 6% rent fees cannot be quantified. First discovery in 2026 after a books-and-records demand supports tolling, but the eliminated fiduciary duty weakens fiduciary-based tolling.

remedy: None on this waived theory; pursue express contract instead.

claim: Bram's alleged fiduciary misconduct in the capital call, dilution, and buyout
direct_or_derivative: direct as to loss of Imani's percentage interest; any company loss from misuse of capital would be derivative
remedy: None on this waived theory; seek contractual declaration and relief.

claim: Affiliate arrangement on terms less favorable than an arm's-length transaction, violating Section 5.4
direct_or_derivative: derivative; the Company bears any excessive cost and receives monetary recovery

limitations.accrual: At the 2022-08-15 arrangement and, subject to proof of separately actionable breaches, each excessive fee payment.
limitations.tolling_argument: On a 2026-10-08 filing assumption, the 2022 and 2023 fixed payments total $180,000 + $195,000 = $375,000 and are presumptively outside three years. Tolling is arguable because the affiliate's identity and fee amounts emerged only from 2026 bank statements; generic summaries disclosed only 'management expenses.' Whether those summaries triggered inquiry notice is unresolved. The 6% rent fees and actual excess over market terms are unknown.

remedy: Company recovery of proved excess over arm's-length terms, potentially with accounting and prospective compliance; no basis to recover all fees without proof.

claim: Failure to disclose the affiliate transaction in writing to all Members within 30 days, violating Section 5.4
direct_or_derivative: direct as to Imani's personal contractual notice right; any recovery of excessive Company payments belongs to the Company

limitations.accrual: Approximately 2022-09-14, 30 days after the 2022-08-15 engagement; later material amendments or separate qualifying transactions, if any, have not been established.
limitations.tolling_argument: The value 1 denotes the entire original nonmonetary disclosure breach, presumptively outside the three-year period absent tolling. Imani says she first learned the affiliate identity and fee amounts in 2026 after a books-and-records demand; generic management-expense summaries support a discovery-based argument. An affirmative act needed for fraudulent-concealment tolling has not been shown.

remedy: Declaration and appropriate disclosure/accounting relief; damages require proof of a distinct loss caused by late notice.

claim: Capital call failed Section 6.3's certified-mail-and-email delivery requirements, so it did not trigger dilution
direct_or_derivative: direct; Imani's own percentage interest was reduced

limitations.accrual: 2026-09-25 dilution following the 2026-08-20 notice and 2026-09-20 funding deadline.

remedy: Declaration that the call did not produce a Dilution Event, restoration of the 18% interest, and injunction against a buyout premised on this event.

claim: Capital call lacked the bona fide Company purpose required by Section 6.3
direct_or_derivative: direct as to dilution; any diversion of Company funds would be derivative

limitations.accrual: 2026-09-25 dilution; the challenged notice is dated 2026-08-20.

remedy: Declaration and restoration of interest if the stated purpose was insufficient or pretextual; discovery into need and use of proceeds.

claim: Manager failed Section 6.3's good-faith fair-value requirement or calculated 6.1% without a contractually supportable method
direct_or_derivative: direct; Imani personally lost percentage interest
remedy: Declaration invalidating or correcting dilution, accounting of the calculation, and valuation evidence.

claim: Alternative implied-covenant challenge to arbitrary use of valuation or capital-call discretion where Section 6.3 leaves a gap
direct_or_derivative: direct as to Imani's dilution injury
remedy: Declaration or damages for proven bad-faith deprivation of Imani's contractual bargain; plead only as an alternative for a genuine contractual gap.

claim: Company lacks a Section 9.2 buyout right if there was no valid Dilution Event and Imani did not withdraw
direct_or_derivative: direct; the proposed purchase concerns Imani's own interest

limitations.accrual: 2026-10-01 offer; a completed forced purchase has not been shown.

remedy: Declaration and, if needed, injunction preventing a purchase based on an invalid event; no standalone right to market value if Section 9.2 validly applies.
